cpos.scope_note: Official swa pages confirm the tariff structure effective 2026-04-01 applies to Adhoc-Payment and card/direct payment without registration; exact numeric tariff components are corroborated by contemporaneous reporting quoting the swa change.

cpos.reason: Official Stadtwerkedrive tariff page publishes card tariff but explicitly says ad-hoc/third-party tariffs may differ. Current station-level direct prices vary by EVSE/power (e.g. AC 0.51 €/kWh, DC/HPC 0.55 €/kWh with different blocking fees), so no network-wide value is extrapolated.
cpos.unblock: Authoritative public QR/direct-payment checkout or official EVSE-to-ad-hoc-tariff feed covering the DE*BOX estate.

cpos.reason: Official site confirms direct credit-card charging at Stadtwerke Münster stations, but the numeric tariff surfaced publicly is the Momente/Business charging-card tariff, not a verified ad-hoc direct-payment tariff. No substitution is made.
